test.description: Same as geojson-z0/geojson-crossing-z0, but with regular vector tiles instead of a GeoJSON source: tile generators also duplicate geometry near the antimeridian into the zoom 0 tile buffer (shifted by 360 degrees), so the clip must apply to all vector sources. Only the zoom 0 tile is kept, since that is the only one this framing reads. Tiles generated with `tippecanoe -z3 --no-tile-compression -e tiles repro.geojson` from two polygons (lon 130..180 and lon 150..230), then renamed to z-x-y.mvt.
